purification_method: precursor washed and dried at 60 °C overnight; after activation washed with 1 M HCl and deionized water and dried at 60 °C overnight
activation_method: chemical activation with KOH, KOH:C mass ratio 1:1 (1 g pre-carbonized material), 800 °C for 2 h under N2 flow 50 cm3/h, heating rate 5 °C/min
source_location: main p.10 (journal p. 528), Fig. 6f, OP1 total adsorption (filled triangles)
notes: marker partly hidden by overlapping markers or split from a merged group (12 px); centroid less certain; archive: fig6f_op1_ads.json; wt% convention W2 stated in Sec. 2.3 (mass of adsorbed H2 / (mass of sample + mass of adsorbed H2)); high-pressure H2 isotherm, SETARAM Hy-Energy PCTPro-2000 manometric (Sieverts) system, 77 K liquid-nitrogen bath; sample ~200 mg ("approximately 200 mg"); degassed at 250 °C for 12 h under 10^-6 mbar (stored 1e-4 Pa); single batch, no repeats; total uptake computed by the authors from the excess isotherm with Eq.
